Krobus has gotten their hands on nine mysterious roses. 
On their own they seem like ordinary flowers, they're not even worth that much.
But you have some old knowledge to turn these roses into something even more magical.
Where this knowledge is from? Oh well... That doesn't matter dear. But maybe you shouldn't trust every magical brew?

The roses take their time to grow, one season at least. 
To unlock their full potential you need to be brave enough to conquer the deepest depth of the mines.

Since people dislike discovering stuff for themselves, here is everything you need to know.
If you still downloaded this mod with the intention of finding out the mystery yourself, thank you. 




• The Roses are available at Krobus Shop
• They take all season to grow, but they do regrow and can be planted and harvested in any season
• Their main purpose is to be turned into Potions via the kitchen. You'll need some Monster Loot though
• Most of the potions offer big buffs to make your Stardew Life a bit easier.
